overall_goal: Prepare uttapam pancake batter by mixing the powder with water

goals.description: Retrieve the pancake mix box and a mixing bowl
goals.rationale: The person gathers the initial items needed, including the cardboard box containing the mix and a bowl.
The person opens the cardboard box and removes the inner plastic pouch containing the pancake mix.

goals.description: Get scissors and cut open the pancake mix pouch
goals.rationale: The person retrieves scissors from a drawer and uses them to cut open the plastic pouch of pancake mix.

goals.description: Weigh and pour the pancake mix into a bowl
goals.rationale: The person uses a weighing balance to measure the pancake mix as they pour it from the pouch into a bowl.

goals.description: Transfer the pancake mix to a larger bowl and add more mix
goals.rationale: The person moves the measured mix into a larger bowl and continues to pour additional mix from the pouch.

goals.description: Retrieve a spoon and a cup of water
goals.rationale: The person gets a spoon from a drawer and fills a cup with water at the sink to use for the batter.

goals.description: Pour water and mix the batter
goals.rationale: The person pours the water into the bowl with the pancake mix and stirs it with the spoon to form a batter.

goals.description: Add more pancake mix and water to adjust the batter consistency
goals.rationale: The person adds additional pancake mix and water to the bowl, then stirs continuously to achieve the desired thin batter consistency.
